#!/bin/sh
# Minimal inventory application: periodically logs stock-check events via syslog.
i=0
while :; do
  i=$((i+1))
  count=$((RANDOM_SEED=i, (i*37) % 500 + 1))
  logger -t inventory -p local0.info "inventory check #$i: $count items in stock, sku=SKU-$((i%20))"
  sleep 10
done
EOF
